title: Moving On
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Andy struggles emotionally after Erin ends their relationship and begins dating Pete, which Andy discovers and reacts to with hurt and conflict. Meanwhile, Pam prepares for a job interview in Philadelphia arranged by Jim but faces uncertainty after not getting the job. Dwight and Angela deal with caring for Dwight's ailing aunt Shirley, leading to humorous and tense moments. Toby pursues a personal interest in the Scranton Strangler case, and workplace dynamics shift as Alice and Pete navigate their past relationship while sharing a workspace. The episode explores themes of moving on, emotional struggles, and changing relationships among the office staff.
